# Results (generated by `scripts/run_demo.py`)

Run: 28.0 days from 2027-01-01, 600 s step, 800 Fibonacci users + named sites, 5° elevation mask, full force model (degree-3 lunar field, Earth + Sun).

## Frames

- sub-Earth libration envelope: ±8.1° lon, ±6.9° lat; mean (-0.02°, -0.13°)
- PA↔ME rotation 0.02886° → up to 875 m on the surface

## Single-point-solution consistency

250 user/epoch samples: simulated RMS error ÷ (PDOP·σ) has median 0.997 and scatter 4.8 % (sampling noise alone with 150 draws is ~3.3 %; the excess is not investigated).
